title: Sync.so AI Visual Dubbing and Lip-Sync Studio
summary: Sync.so is a studio-grade AI platform that provides high-fidelity visual dubbing and lip-syncing for professional video production. It enables seamless voice cloning and alignment, preserving actor mannerisms and emotional nuances across multiple languages.
research_notes: Features include Active Speaker Detection (ASD-1) for multi-person scenes and professional workflow integration via an Adobe Premiere Pro plugin and robust API.

evolution.summary: The platform has evolved from legacy GAN-based models to the diffusion-based Lipsync-2 and the current Sync-3 flagship. Sync-3 introduces native 4K processing, advanced obstruction detection, and full-shot visual dubbing that maintains skin textures and lighting consistency.
